# Check erase-folder response counts before pairing responses with folder IDs

The shared erase-folder operation pairs requested folder IDs with response messages using zip and then returns success. It checks errors only in those pairs and does not first validate the count. If a parsed response list is shorter, unmatched IDs have no checked response; if longer, extra errors can be ignored. The generic response list has an empty default. The nearby message-deletion operation demonstrates a count check before zip. A scoped robustness recommendation is to retain that cardinality check when pairing protocol results with requested IDs. This is conditional static analysis; no malformed response, remote partial success or resulting local data loss was exercised.

Scope: rust/ews/erase-folder.
